RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026

Post Date: September 16, 2026

5:06 pm

Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS), has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Medical Officer posts. This recruitment is for 600 positions. The RUHS application form has started on 14 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 13 October 2026. The minimum age required is 22 years & the maximum age is 45 years as of 01 January 2027. Candidates must check the complete details for the RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 provided below.

 How To Check & Download SSC Phase 13 Result 2026 
  • Visit the official SSC website.
  • On the homepage, find and click on the “Answer Key” section.
  • Look for the notification titled “Selection Post Phase-13 Result 2026”.
  • Click on the provided link to access the login page.
  • Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Date of Birth.
  • Submit the details to view your Result and Response Sheet.
  • Download the answer key PDF and save it to your device.
  • Match your responses with the official key to calculate your estimated score.
  • If you find any discrepancies, you can submit objections within the given time frame by following the instructions provided in the notification.
  • After the objection window closes, SSC will release the result, which will be used for result preparation.

  • You’ll be redirected to a PDF titled “SECOND ROUND SEAT ALLOTMENT RESULT OF ITICAT‑2025”, published on 31 July 2025

  • Depending on the system, you may need to log in using your Roll Number or Registration Number (and possibly a password or DOB) to access your individual allotment status
  • 5. View and Download Result
  • Check your details in the PDF: your name, allotted institute/trade, category rank, etc. Save or print the PDF for admission use
